facts.fact: The Plano Estratégico da Educação 2022-2026 (Ministry of Education, July 2023) names SIGE throughout: consolidating it as the sector's administrative and academic management platform, new modules including one on special educational needs, a ministerial order regulating its use, and costed activities such as 3 million escudos to extend it to pre-school and private schools.

The plan assigns SIGE's technical management, evolutionary maintenance and new modules to the ministry's Direção Geral da Comunicação, Tecnologia e Multimédia, with the Direção Nacional da Educação leading its use in schools and integration work involving NOSI (July 2023).

The plan lists a functional SIGE among the system's strengths and plans to reinforce its use in basic education units and increase its use in secondary schools; it records as a weakness that SIGE had not been put into effect in technical schools, and its extension to pre-school and technical education is still to come (July 2023).

The plan gives no figure for schools using SIGE in July 2023; it sets as results to be reached 'SIGE functional in all schools', 'functional at 100%', in full use by all teachers, and 98% of pre-school establishments and private schools using it.

systems.country_label: SIGE, expanded in the plan variously as Sistema de Informação e Gestão da Educação, Sistema Integrado de Gestão Educativa and Sistema de Informação de Gestão da Educação
systems.tiers: basic and secondary schools; not in technical schools; extension to pre-school, private schools and adult education planned

note: Passages only. SIGE is classed emis on the plan's description of it as the academic management platform used by teachers, with a module to follow pupils with special needs and parameters for assessment; the passages do not say in terms what schools enter or how often, so no `kept` fact is taken.
